item.title: Puritan Moral Psychology and the Genealogy of American Progressivism
item.description: This report analyzes the formal thesis that modern American progressivism inherited and secularized a durable moral-political grammar first institutionalized in New England Puritanism. The grammar includes covenantal mission, collective guilt, moralized authority, public scrutiny of conduct, and disciplinary institutions.
